work.name: Helixiora
work.position: Senior Data Engineer & AI Solutions Architect
work.summary: Senior data and AI lead delivering customer-facing projects end to end: scalable Azure and AWS data platforms, agentic AI and RAG, LLM fine-tuning and serving, full-stack SaaS, and secure cloud operations with strong stakeholder partnership and mentorship.
responsibilities: Client Delivery & Solution Leadership: Led customer-facing project delivery by partnering with stakeholders to design and deploy innovative, end-to-end solutions across Azure and AWS, translating business problems into scalable data, AI, and platform architectures.

Data Engineering: Designed and built large-scale Azure Databricks pipelines using PySpark and SQL to ingest, clean, and transform multi-source datasets (Blob, CosmosDB); implemented real-time streaming pipelines with Kafka; and delivered curated Delta Lake layers aligned with Kimball-style dimensional modeling and data warehouse best practices to power analytics and ML workloads.

Full-Stack SaaS: Led the end-to-end development and deployment of multiple production-grade AI SaaS platforms, serving millions of users. Built full-stack solutions using FastAPI, Next.js, and React Native with Expo for Android and iOS, integrating OAuth 2.0 authentication, PostgreSQL, and Stripe to deliver secure, scalable, cloud-native products.

AI Agents: Architected and deployed multi-stage agentic RAG, Chatbot and automation systems using OpenAI Agent SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Pinecone, and custom Python pipelines (Slack, Google Drive), enabling accurate context retrieval and intelligent workflow automation.

Machine Learning Engineering: Built feature-ready datasets in Delta Lake, supported downstream ML model training, and optimized vector search & reranking pipelines, accelerating model iteration cycles and improving retrieval accuracy across enterprise LLM solutions.

LLM Fine-Tuning: Fine-tuned domain-specific LLMs using Unsloth for specialized business use cases, optimized model performance with LoRA, and deployed the resulting fine-tuned models into production AI workflows, significantly improving inference accuracy.
LLM Inference & Deployment: Deployed vLLM and llama.cpp for high-performance LLM serving, optimized for low latency and high-concurrency workloads.

Infrastructure, DevOps & Security: Designed and automated CI/CD pipelines deploying containerized applications to AWS ECS using Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions; strengthened platform reliability with load balancing and scalable microservices; and implemented Zero-Trust controls, SSL/TLS hardening, firewall rules, and secure API gateways to ensure robust authentication, authorization, and data protection across SaaS and data platforms.

Monitoring & Observability: Set up centralized logging, metrics, and dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana, enabling real-time performance monitoring, alerting, and proactive issue resolution across production environments.

Team Leadership & Mentorship: Led and mentored junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, architectural guidance, use of AI tools, and best-practice coaching, raising team capability and ensuring high quality engineering delivery.

professionalProjects.name: Inappropriate Language Filter with LLM Fine-Tuning
